description: Na₄MgV₂O₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.69 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.36 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.73 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-57°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.03 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and edges with three equivalent VO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.40 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and two equivalent V atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent V atoms to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₄V₂ octahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two equivalent V atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and two equivalent V atoms.
